content.text: I'll check current pricing first, since it changes often and matters for a 10-person team.

input.query: Sentry pricing plans Team Business error monitoring 2026
Rollbar pricing plans 2026 events per month
Bugsnag pricing plans 2026 Team Business events

content.text:
**Recommendation: Sentry**, unless you have a specific reason to prefer one of the others. Pricing is the least certain part of this comparison, so check the official pricing pages before you commit.

**Pricing (from third-party aggregators, not verified against vendor pages):**

- **Sentry:** Free Developer tier. Team is about $26–29/month and Business about $80–89/month, depending on whether it's billed annually. Team and Business reportedly include 50K errors and 5M spans. Sentry does charge per seat on paid plans; this search didn't confirm the seat pricing, so check it.
- **Rollbar:** Free tier with 5K events/month. Paid tiers are event-based and sources disagree on the numbers (roughly $13–99/month for the Essentials/Advanced entry levels). Rollbar says it doesn't charge per seat, which helps a 10-person team.
- **Bugsnag:** The searches found no reliable 2026 pricing. Its tiers appear to be Free, Select, Preferred, and Enterprise. The Select (~$20/month) and Preferred (~$33/month) figures come from aggregators, and at least one source says paid prices are contact-sales only. Treat Bugsnag's cost as unknown until you get a quote.

**Comparison:**

| | Sentry | Rollbar | Bugsnag |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ecosystem | Broadest: errors, tracing, performance, replays, cron and uptime monitors | Errors-focused, with replays and some AI-related features | Errors-focused, with release health and stability scoring |
| Language and platform SDKs | Widest range | Broad | Strong on mobile and common web stacks |
| Free tier | Yes, usable for a small team | Yes, 5K events/month | Yes, size unclear across sources |
| Pricing model | Per event, plus per seat on paid plans | Per event, no per-seat charges | Per event, paid tiers largely quote-based |
| Best fit | Teams that want one tool for errors and performance | Teams that want predictable costs without seats | Mobile-heavy teams that care about stability metrics |

**Why Sentry for your team:** it has the most mature free tier and the widest integrations, and it can grow into performance monitoring without adding a second vendor. The main risk is per-seat cost and event overage on busy services. Rollbar is the strongest alternative if seat costs are the concern.

**Before you decide:**

1. Check current prices on sentry.io/pricing, rollbar.com/pricing, and bugsnag.com/pricing (or ask Bugsnag for a quote).
2. Estimate your monthly error volume. Most of the cost difference comes from it.
3. Trial the top two on one real service for a week.

Sources:
- [Sentry Pricing 2026 breakdown (Middleware)](https://wpadmin.middleware.io/?p=17534)
- [Sentry Pricing Plans & History (PricingSaaS)](https://pricingsaas.com/companies/sentry)
- [Sentry pricing (CostBench)](https://costbench.com/software/developer-tools/sentry)
- [Rollbar pricing (official)](https://www.rollbar.com/pricing)
- [Rollbar Pricing Explained (Rollbar blog)](https://rollbar.com/blog/rollbar-pricing-explained-plans-features-and-what-you-actually-pay)
- [Rollbar pricing overview (Vendr)](https://www.vendr.com/marketplace/rollbar)
- [Bugsnag plans and pricing (CostBench)](https://costbench.com/software/error-tracking/bugsnag/)
- [Bugsnag pricing change, February 2026 (CostBench)](https://costbench.com/changelog/bugsnag-price-decrease-2026-02/)
